# nico_expected_rack_group (Data Source)

Expected Rack Group declares an external topology identifier, racks, and device members for an NVLink domain. Manufacturer and physical location are conveyed through the same well-known `chassis.*` and `location.*` labels used by Expected Racks.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "nico_expected_rack_group" "example" {
  id = "resource-uuid"
}

output "expected_rack_group_name" {
  value = data.nico_expected_rack_group.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) ID of the resource to retrieve. When set, returns a single resource.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the Site to filter Expected Rack Groups by

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Rack Group was created
- `description` (String) Human-readable description of the Expected Rack Group
- `labels` (Map of String) User-defined key-value pairs for organizing and categorizing Expected Rack Groups. Well-known keys (`chassis.*`, `location.*`) are used to convey chassis identity and physical location.
- `name` (String) Human-readable name of the Expected Rack Group
- `protocol` (String) Rack fabric protocol. Null only for declarations created before protocol became required.
- `rack_group_id` (String) Operator-supplied identifier for the rack group (opaque string; UUID syntax is not required). Unique within a Site.
- `racks` (Attributes List) Ordered racks and their devices. Arrays are always present, including empty lists. Rack IDs and device identity tuples are unique across the group, with case-sensitive comparison. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--racks))
- `site` (String) Site details when requested through includeRelation; otherwise null.
- `topology` (String) External group-level NVLink topology identifier.
- `updated` (String) ISO 8601 datetime when the Expected Rack Group was last updated

<a id="nestedatt--racks"></a>
### Nested Schema for `racks`

Read-Only:

- `members` (Attributes List) Ordered devices in this rack. Device identities are unique across all racks in the group. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--racks--members))
- `rack_id` (String) Non-blank, case-sensitive external rack identifier, unique within the group.

<a id="nestedatt--racks--members"></a>
### Nested Schema for `racks.members`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) Non-blank opaque external device inventory identifier.
- `manufacturer` (String) Non-blank manufacturer name.
- `type` (String) Case-sensitive REST rack component type. NVSwitch maps to Switch in Core.
